title: Milk, wine, salad: how your food will be affected by the summer of heat

paragraphs.en: As parts of the UK swelter through a fifth successive climate crisis-driven heatwave and nearly three-quarters of England remains in drought, how are six homegrown products faring?
paragraphs.zh: 英国部分地区正遭受第五次由气候危机引发的连续热浪，英格兰近四分之三的地区仍处于干旱之中。在此背景下，六种本土农产品现状如何？

paragraphs.en: On her farm in Durham on Monday where she was vaccinating sheep, Clare Wise stopped and stood still. For the first time in weeks, it had begun to rain. “We didn’t think of taking cover, we just stayed out and enjoyed it!” she says.
paragraphs.zh: 周一，在达勒姆的农场上，克莱尔·怀斯正在给羊接种疫苗时停了下来，静静地站着。几周以来，天第一次开始下雨。“我们压根没想着避雨，就那样待在雨里享受！”她说。

paragraphs.en: Farmers farther south were less lucky, and the continuing drought , as well as causing distress for animals in danger of overheating, is storing up problems for livestock farmers this winter. Grass growth has been about half of what it should be by this time of year and mowing excess grass in summer is where most get their winter feed.
paragraphs.zh: 更靠南的农民就没这么幸运了。持续的干旱不仅让面临过热危险的家畜饱受折磨，也给养殖户这个冬天的生计埋下了隐患。此时节草本应长到约一半的高度，而大多数养殖户正是在夏季收割多余牧草来储备冬季饲料的。

paragraphs.en: “This would be the peak season for collecting winter forage, but we have not been able to do that,” says Wise, who is also the acting livestock board chief for the National Farmers’ Union. “Grass growth has completely stalled.”
paragraphs.zh: “这本来是收集冬季草料的旺季，但我们却做不到。”怀斯说，她还担任全国农民联盟牲畜委员会代理主席。“牧草的生长已经完全停滞了。”

paragraphs.en: Some farmers have been forced to dip into their winter feed stores; others will need to supplement their scant supplies with bought-in feed.
paragraphs.zh: 一些农民被迫动用冬季饲料储备；另一些农民则需要购买饲料来补充他们本已匮乏的储备。

paragraphs.en: Milk production is down, but so far only slightly – by about 1%, according to the Agriculture and Horticulture Development Board (AHDB), as cows have less to eat and are discouraged by the heat. Sheep shearers have been in short supply, making it difficult for farmers to make their flocks comfortable.
paragraphs.zh: 据农业与园艺发展委员会（AHDB）称，牛奶产量有所下降，但目前幅度还不大——大约下降了1%——因为奶牛吃到的草料减少，而且天气炎热也让它们提不起精神。剪羊毛的工人一直短缺，使农民难以让羊群过得舒适。

paragraphs.en: For future years, farmers can grow trees and higher hedges to provide shade for their beasts, says Tom Cantillon, an analyst at the Energy and Climate Intelligence Unit (ECIU) thinktank. Some with bigger herds might consider air conditioning in their sheds and milking parlours.
paragraphs.zh: 智库“能源与气候情报组”（ECIU）的分析师汤姆·坎蒂永表示，为了未来的年份，农民可以种植树木、加高树篱，为牲畜遮阴。有些饲养规模较大的农民可能会考虑在棚舍和挤奶厅里安装空调。

paragraphs.en: But for many livestock farmers, the fear is that this year is just the beginning .
paragraphs.zh: 但对许多养殖户来说，他们担心今年只是个开始。
